environment.description: Same Node.js 18 container on ECS Fargate. The ALB listener on port 443 is configured with mutual TLS (mTLS) verification mode set to 'passthrough' with a trust store referencing an internal CA bundle (arn:aws:acm-pca:us-east-1:123456789012:certificate-authority/abc-def-123). However, the actual enforcement happens at the NGINX ingress sidecar container (port 8443) running in the same task definition, which terminates TLS with `ssl_verify_client on` and `ssl_client_certificate /etc/nginx/certs/internal-ca.pem`. The sidecar proxies to localhost:4000 only after successful client certificate validation. The ALB target group points to port 8443 (the sidecar), not port 4000 directly. Additionally, the ECS task's network mode is 'awsvpc' with a security group that only allows inbound from the ALB's security group on port 8443, and the container port 4000 has no port mapping in the task definition's network bindings — it's only accessible via localhost within the task.

config.alb_listener: HTTPS:443, mutual TLS passthrough mode, trust store arn:aws:acm-pca:us-east-1:123456789012:certificate-authority/abc-def-123
config.sidecar: nginx:1.25 with ssl_verify_client on, ssl_client_certificate /etc/nginx/certs/internal-ca.pem, proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:4000
config.port_mappings: containerPort 8443 only (node app on 4000 not exposed)
config.client_cert_requirement: X.509 certificate signed by internal ACM-PCA CA, CN must match service registry entry
